description.value: The Siding Café is a family-owned restaurant, gift shop, and licensed liquor retailer that has been a fixture of the tiny mountain village of Field, BC since 1991, occupying a historic 1915 building in the heart of Yoho National Park. The creative menu of bowls, paninis, and sandwiches is built around fresh ingredients, and a patio with mountain views makes it a natural stop for hikers and road travellers alike. Cyclists passing through on the Trans-Canada corridor will find grab-and-go items, local wines and microbrews, and a relaxed atmosphere welcoming to those fresh off the trail.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thesidingcafe.ca is live and content-rich, confirming an operating café at 318 Stephen Ave, Field BC with phone (250) 343-6002 and an extensive current menu. Takeout/grab-and-go service and vegetarian/GF menu items are explicitly confirmed by the menu and homepage text. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill appears anywhere on the site. Two concerns are flagged: the url_discovery_notes warn the business may have been sold and could reopen under a different name, and the website contains injected casino-advertising content suggesting possible site compromise or unusual SEO arrangements.
concerns: url_discovery_notes flag this business as 'Reported sold; may reopen as Yoho Corner Store' — ownership or name change is possible; verify current trading status before publication.

Website homepage and a dedicated subpage (/nature-and-gaming/) contain injected online-casino advertising content (CasinoHex/Skrill), suggesting the site may have been compromised or is hosting paid SEO placements; does not affect the café's legitimacy but is unusual.
OSM record assigns community 'Unknown / Kootenays' but Field, BC is in the Columbia-Shuswap / Yoho National Park area, not the Kootenays — community tag may need correction.
OSM name is 'Siding Cafe' (no leading 'The', no accent on 'e') while the website consistently uses 'The Siding Café'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active website with current menu, confirmed address, phone, and recent visitor reviews indicates an open, publicly accessible café useful to touring cyclists on the Hwy 1 corridor through Yoho National Park.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes house-made Veggie Burger (black bean and carrot), tofu Rice Bowl, and explicitly states the Daily Soup is 'Always vegetarian and Gluten-free'
